transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Doctor. Thank you so much for seeing me. Um, well, my boss actually suggested I come in. It's really nothing terrible, I promise, I just... I want to make sure I'm doing everything right, you know? 

Lately, I've just been having a little bit of trouble with... well, forgetting some scheduled callbacks and work orders. Just basic follow-ups on repairs that I promised people I'd handle. It's, um, it's piled up just a little bit, which is honestly a bit embarrassing to admit. I really do try to do a good job. But work sent me here because there's a chance for me to move up soon, and they don't want me to lose my shot over something silly like this. 

Does that... does that make sense? I hope I'm explaining it okay.
Did you experience similar difficulties with attention or organization when you were growing up in school?

Um, well... yes, I suppose so. I hope it's okay to admit that. I remember being, well, a little bit like this way back in grade school, honestly long before I ever had any of this pressure at work. 

My teachers always made sure to tell my parents I was a bright girl, which was really nice of them. I just... I had a little habit of misplacing my papers, or I'd somehow miss parts of the directions when they were explaining things to the class. They'd just have to give me little reminders to finish my classwork sometimes. It wasn't that I was trying to be a bad student or anything, I promise! I always wanted to do a good job, just like I do now. 

Is that... does that help answer your question? I want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.
Have you ever struggled with feeling physically restless, fidgety, or having a hard time sitting still?

Oh, um... no, not really. I don't think I've ever had a problem with that. I've always been pretty good at sitting quietly, I promise. 

I mean, my job keeps me on my feet a lot, fixing things and moving around the building, but when I need to sit down for paperwork or a meeting, I don't get fidgety or anything like that. Even when I was a little girl, I was never one to bounce off the walls. I was always perfectly happy just... staying put. 

Is that... is that the kind of thing you were looking for? I hope I'm not giving you the wrong answer or messing up your evaluation. I just really don't feel restless like that.
Outside of work, do you often find yourself constantly worrying about many different things in your everyday life?

Oh, um... no, I wouldn't say so. I really try my best to stay positive, I promise. 

I mean, I suppose everyone has little things they think about now and then, like making sure the rent is paid or picking up groceries, but I definitely don't sit around worrying constantly about everything. Outside of work, I'm usually pretty cheerful and easygoing. I don't want you to think I'm a terribly anxious person or anything like that, because I'm really not. I just try to take things one day at a time and keep a smile on my face. 

Is that... is that an okay answer? I just want to make sure I'm giving you exactly what you need to know.
